about: Which code the shadow league's zone-flip detector and exit simulation were copied from, and the hashes of the originals. tests/test_shadowleague_parity.py checks every number here against the files and checks that each verbatim function has the original's exact source text.

sources.where: docs/zoneflip-reel/lib_zoneflip.py.txt on branch claude/keen-pasteur-wav02u; reference copy in this repository: tests/data/zoneflip_original/lib_zoneflip.py.txt

changed.setups: one optional argument b_min (default None = the original); a break at bar b < b_min is not looked at. Nothing else differs.
changed.signals: signals_from_arrays: the same steps on numpy arrays instead of a DataFrame

changed.simulate: the call R.exit_trade(...) is exit_trade(...) (the copy next to it); nothing else differs

paperbot/shadowleague/zoneflip.py.how: numpy and a loop with the arithmetic of pandas ewm(alpha=1/14, adjust=False, min_periods=14); tests compare it with fg_indicators.atr and with pandas, bit for bit

sources.where: research/search/search.py (frozen): OWN_EXPO, OWN_MARGIN, OWN_LIQ and owners_book; the step-by-step version is lib_zoneflip.py owners_curve

paperbot/shadowleague/account.py.rules: sort by (entry time, coin); skip a trade whose entry is before the last taken trade's exit; liquidated when -mae >= OWN_LIQ; equity *= 1 - OWN_MARGIN if liquidated else 1 + max(OWN_EXPO * net, -OWN_MARGIN)
